items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked The Embers with Tyree. ... I also worked with Tyree Glenn at a place two blocks further down… It was in the same block.

ctx.x: What was the repertoire of Tyree Glenn?
Tyree was actually a very, very fine trombonist. But, his vibes playing was a little… He was not that bad, but not that great.
It sounds like music designed for a supper club.
